Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:11:1.hebrew: ואב"א ברחל בת עז בת רחל - וחדא קתני: ברחל בת עז, ואותה עז היתה בת רחל:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:11:1.english: And if you wish, say: With a ewe born to a goat born to a ewe - And [the baraita] teaches one [case]: with a ewe born to a goat, and that goat was born to a ewe.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:11:2.hebrew: ר"מ מחייב - ליתנן לכהן, דחזרה שיות למקומן ולא נדמה הוא. והך רחל בת עז לאו רחל ממש, דהא נקבה לא קדשה בבכורה, אלא מין רחל קאמר:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:11:2.english: Rabbi Meir deems [it] obligated - To give it to the priest, for its ovine nature was restored to its place, and it is not [considered] an animal that resembles [a different species]. And this [mention of] “a ewe born to a goat” [does] not [mean] an actual ewe, as a female is not sanctified as a firstborn; rather, it means [an animal of] the ovine species.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:13:1.hebrew: מודה ר"מ - אע"ג דלענין בכורה סבר חזרה שיות למקומה, הכא בעינן שיהא ממשפחת עזים מששת ימי בראשית:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:13:1.english: Rabbi Meir concedes - Even though with regard to the firstborn he maintains that its ovine nature has returned to its place, here we require that it be from the family of goats from the six days of Creation.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:15:1.hebrew: ה"מ דלא נחית לדרי - כלומר, דאינו נדמה לעז אם אמו, אלא לאמו גופיה הוי נדמה, דאינו דומה לאמו; אבל היכא דנחת לדרי — דלגבי אמו לא הוי נדמה, דדמי לאמו, אלא לגבי אם אמו הוי נדמה — אימא לא. קמ"ל אחד, דבעינן מיוחד מששת ימי בראשית:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:15:1.english: This applies only where it does not trace back to [earlier] generations - That is to say, where it is not [considered] a nidmeh relative to the goat, its mother’s mother, but rather relative to its mother itself it is a nidmeh, as it does not resemble its mother. But where it traces back to [earlier] generations — where relative to its mother it is not a nidmeh, as it resembles its mother, but relative to its mother’s mother it is a nidmeh — I would say no, [it is not disqualified]. [Therefore,] it teaches us “one,” that we require [an animal that is] distinct [of its species] since the six days of Creation.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:15:2.hebrew: ואי מהתם - דאי כתב אחד ולא כתב עז, הוה אמינא: הני מילי דנדמה פסול — לקרבן חובה, כגון שעיר מוסף דראש חדש דחובה הוא, אבל לקרבן נדבה ליתכשר. האי דנקט שעיר ראש חדש — הוא הדין לשעירי רגלים דכתיב בהן אחד, אלא קמא דכולהו נקט:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:15:2.english: And had [it been derived] from there - For had [the verse] written "one" and not written "a goat", I would say: This matter — that an animal resembling [another species] is disqualified — applies to an obligatory offering, such as the Musaf goat of Rosh Chodesh, which is an obligatory offering, but for a voluntary offering let it be fit. As for that which it cited the goat of Rosh Chodesh — the same law applies to the goats of the Festivals, concerning which "one" is written, but it cited the first of them all.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:16:1.english: For its wool - Of a sheep that is not uniquely a sheep throughout its generations.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:19:1.english: Just as an offering that has not changed - For a nidmeh [an animal that resembles another species] is unfit for an offering.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:1:1.hebrew: היינו דקאמר רשב"ג - את אמרת: שתי דורות למטה מצאן ברזל, ותו לא; ואנא אמינא: אפילו עד עשרה דורות נמי פטורין. והוא הדין טפי מעשרה, אלא כי האי מנינא נקט בכמה דוכתי, וקרא נמי נקיט להו, דכתיב (דברים כג): "גם דור עשירי", והן אסורין לעולם. אצטריך למיתני הכי, דאם הוי תני "אפילו ולדי ולדות פטורין", הוה אמינא: הני הוא דפטר רבן גמליאל, טפי מהני לא, כי היכי דשמעינן ליה לתנא קמא דפטר ולדי ולדות, אע"ג דלא מבהמותיו של עובד כוכבים ממש נולדו, ומחייב בולדי [ולדי] ולדות לתת ולדן לכהן — הכי נמי לרשב"ג, אע"ג דפטר בולד ולדי, בחד דרא טפי מחייב:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:1:1.english: This is what Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel said - You say: Two generations below the iron flock, and no more; and I say: Even until ten generations, they are also exempt. And the same applies to more than ten [generations], but [the tanna] used this number [ten] as it is used in several places; and Scripture also used it, as it is written (Deuteronomy 23:3): "Even to the tenth generation," and yet they are forbidden forever. It was necessary to teach [it] this way, for had he taught, "Even the offspring of offspring are exempt," I would have said: It is [only] these that Rabban [Shimon ben] Gamliel exempts, [but] more than these, no — just as we have heard regarding the first tanna that he exempts the offspring of offspring, even though they were not born from the actual animals of the gentile, and he deems the offspring of [the offspring of] offspring liable to give their offspring to the priest; so too according to Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, even though he exempts the offspring of offspring, in one generation further he deems [them] liable.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:1:2.hebrew: אלא לרב הונא דאמר לא נחת תנא קמא - למיפטר דרי, דלא פטר אלא ולדות של צאן ברזל, הואיל ויצאו מבהמותיו ממש של עובד כוכבים — למה ליה לרשב"ג למימר "עד עשרה דורות"? לימא "אפילו ולדי ולדות פטורין", ושמעינן מינה: כי היכי דפטר ולדי ולדות, אע"ג דלא מבהמותיו של עובד כוכבים ממש יצאו, הוא הדין נמי עד עשרה דורות:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:1:2.english: Rather, according to Rav Huna, who says the first tanna did not descend - To exempt [subsequent] generations, as he exempted only the offspring of iron-sheep property, since they directly emerged from the actual animals of the gentile — why did Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel need to say: “Even until ten generations”? Let him say: “Even the offspring of offspring are exempt,” and we would understand from it: Just as he exempts the offspring of offspring, even though they did not directly emerge from the actual animals of the gentile, the same applies even until ten generations.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:1:3.hebrew: אהעמיד קאי - שהעמיד ולדות תחת אמותיהן קאי, דנחת תנא קמא למיפטר דרי:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:1:3.english: Is referring to "he established" - He is referring to [the case where the Jew] established offspring in place of their mothers, as [in that case] the first tanna descended to exempt generations.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:20:1.hebrew: אלא מעתה, משום דהדלה על גבי תאינה, חשבת ליה שינוי:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:20:1.english: If that is so, [just] because he trellised [it] over a fig tree, do you consider it a change?

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:20:2.english: This one, its scent has changed - The wine of that grapevine.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:21:2.hebrew: א"א לצמצם - שיצאו שני ראשיהן כאחד, אלא האחד יצא תחלה, ולא ידעינן הי ניהו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:21:2.english: It is impossible to coincide precisely - [That is,] that both of their heads emerged as one; rather, one emerged first, and we do not know which one it is.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:22:1.hebrew: ור"ט - מפרש וקאמר, בורר את היפה. מפרש בגמ' טעמא:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:22:1.english: And Rabbi Tarfon - Explains and says: [The priest] chooses the better [one]. The Gemara explains the reason.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:22:2.english: They assess between them - It is explained in the Gemara that the priest takes the lean [one].

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:22:3.hebrew: והשני - שנשאר לישראל, ירעה עד שיסתאב ואח"כ יאכל, דספק בכור הוא; הילכך, אינו נשחט תמים. ובאותו של כהן לא אצטריך למימר, דודאי אינו נשחט עד שיהא בו מום, דבזמן הזה מיירי; א"נ, בזמן הבית מיירי, ודכהן לא חזי להקרבה, וספק בכור הוא, ואיכא למיחש משום חולין בעזרה, לפיכך נמי יאכל במומו. והאי דנקט של ישראל ירעה עד שיסתאב — משום דבעי למימר וחייב במתנות גבי ישראל, דאילו כהן פטור מן המתנות לגמרי, כדמפרש בשחיטת חולין בפרק הזרוע והלחיים (חולין דף קלב.); הילכך, תנא כולה מתניתין בישראל. מיהו, דכהן נמי ירעה עד שיסתאב, ויאכלנו במומו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:22:3.english: And the second - which remains for the Israelite: it must graze until it becomes blemished, and afterward it may be eaten, for it is of uncertain firstborn status; therefore, it may not be slaughtered unblemished. And regarding that of the priest, it was not necessary to state [this], for it certainly is not slaughtered until it has a blemish, as [the Mishnah] is speaking of the present era; or alternatively, it is speaking of the Temple era, and that [one] of the priest is not fit for sacrifice, as it is of uncertain firstborn status and there is concern of [slaughtering] non-sacred [animals] in the Temple courtyard; therefore, it too may [only] be eaten in its blemish. And as for that which it formulated [that the lamb] of the Israelite "must graze until it becomes blemished" — [this is] because it wanted to state "and is obligated in the gifts" regarding the Israelite, whereas a priest is completely exempt from the gifts, as is explained in Shechitat Chullin in the chapter [entitled] Hazero'a VehaLechayayim (Chullin 132a); therefore, it taught the entire Mishnah with respect to the Israelite. However, that [one] of the priest as well must graze until it becomes blemished, and he eats it in its blemish.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:2:1.hebrew: אימא הן וולדות - דמשמע תרי דרי: הן הולדות, וולדות אחרים:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:2:1.english: Say: They and the offspring - Which implies two generations: “they” [refers to] the offspring, and “offspring” [refers to] other offspring.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:3:1.hebrew: אימא הן וולדות - כלומר, הן הולדות עצמן, ולא תימא וולדות:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:3:1.english: Say: They, offspring - That is to say, they are the offspring themselves, and do not say "[and] offspring."

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:6:1.hebrew: מגז כבשי יתחמם - אלמא: בת חימום קרי גז, דלא בת חימום — לא קרי גז. והך עז בת רחל — צמרה קשה, דצמר עזים קשה הוא:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:6:1.english: “With the fleece of my sheep he would warm himself” - Thus, [Scripture] calls “fleece” [only that which is] capable of providing warmth; that which is not capable of providing warmth, it does not call “fleece.” And this goat born of a ewe — its wool is coarse, for goats’ hair is coarse.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:7:1.hebrew: חוששין לזרע האב - אם שוחט האב והבן ביום אחד. והילכך, רבי מאיר מחייב: אם שחטו ובתו, חייב, הואיל וזה דומה לו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:7:1.english: One is concerned with the father’s seed - If one slaughters the father and the offspring on one day. And therefore, Rabbi Meir deems [him] liable: if he slaughtered it and its daughter, he is liable, since this [offspring] resembles it.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:7:2.hebrew: אין חוששין - בעז בת עז, ושחט אותה ואת אביה ביום אחד:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:7:2.english: One is not concerned - In [the case of] a goat [that is the] daughter of a goat, and one slaughtered it and its father on one day.

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:8:1.hebrew: כי היכי דפליגי חנניה ורבנן - בשחיטת חולין בפרק אותו ואת בנו (חולין דף עח:), דחנניה מחייב וחכמים פוטרין:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:8:1.english: Just as Ḥananya and the Rabbis disagree - In [tractate] Sheḥitat Ḥullin, in the chapter [entitled] Oto Ve'et Beno (Ḥullin 78b), where Ḥananya deems [one] liable and the Sages exempt [him].

Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:9:1.hebrew: ברחל בת רחל - וגבי עז בת רחל, עז בת עז בת רחל מיירי:
Rashi on Bekhorot 17a:9:1.english: With a ewe born to a ewe - And regarding “a goat born to a ewe,” it is dealing with a goat born to a goat born to a ewe.

Tosafot on Bekhorot 17a:13:1.hebrew: בשעיר של ראש חדש - קמא נקט, וה"ה שעירי רגלים, דהכי נמי כתב בהו "אחד":
Tosafot on Bekhorot 17a:13:1.english: “With regard to the goat of the New Moon” - [He] cited the first [one], and the same law applies to the goats of the Festivals, for it is also written regarding them, “one.”

Tosafot on Bekhorot 17a:6:1.hebrew: ולית ליה הא דתנא ר' ישמעאל כבשים שצמרן קשה כו' - לא הוה מצי למיפרך דנימעט עז בת רחל מקרא דממעטין (חולין דף קלז.) שער עזים מ"לעמוד ולשרת" — דבעינן דבר הראוי לשירות, ולאפוקי נוצה של עזים — דדילמא כיון דהוי ממין הראוי לשירות, שהיא בת רחל, סגי בהכי:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 17a:6:1.english: “And doesn’t he accept that which Rabbi Yishmael taught: Sheep whose wool is coarse, etc.” - [The Gemara] could not have objected that we should exclude a goat that is the offspring of a ewe from the verse from which goat hair is excluded (Chullin 137a), from “to stand to serve” [Deut. 18:5] — as we require something fit for [priestly] service, to the exclusion of goat down — for perhaps since it is from a species fit for service, as it is the offspring of a ewe, that is sufficient.

Tosafot on Bekhorot 17a:7:1.hebrew: ברחל שילדה מין עז ואביו תייש - והא דנקט "מין עז" — לרבותא: דאע"ג דהועיל זרע האב לשנות הולד למין עז כמותו, אפילו הכי לא חיישי רבנן לזרע האב. ומיהו, דפריך "ליפלגו בחוששין לזרע האב בעלמא" — לא חייש לרבותא זו:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 17a:7:1.english: With a ewe that gave birth to a goat of sorts and its father was a goat - And that which [the Gemara] stated "a goat of sorts" is to teach a novel point: that even though the father's seed was effective in changing the offspring into a goat of sorts like himself, even so the Rabbis are not concerned with the father's seed. However, the one who objects, "Let them disagree regarding [whether one is] concerned with the father's seed in general," does not take this novelty into account.
